datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions across Niger using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing different IPC scenarios were compiled into quarterly medium-term projections for 2015, with snapshots captured in January, April, July, and October.
